review_scope: Implementation and CPU-validation evidence only; no training, inference, resource, dataset, split or provenance approval.

independently_verified.tests_outcome: All pass. Actual adapter and supervision module bytes were executed; seek.schemas/seek.three_way.core and native_record_audit were stubbed; synthetic collation used PyTorch, not transformers.default_data_collator.
independently_verified.static_training_path_review: Original FastChat/train.py snapshot matches expected 9d175d...; adapter exposes AnnotationDataset and native_processor. CPU validator invokes AutoTokenizer locally and DataLoader, not model.from_pretrained, Trainer.train, backward or optimizer.

accepted_from_supplied_runtime_receipt_n.claimed_real_native_tokenizer: Slow Llama-2 tokenizer at max_length=4096 with Vicuna FastChat preprocessing, local tokenizer assets
accepted_from_supplied_runtime_receipt_n.limitations: Tokenizer/model assets, corpus records, annotated sidecar contents and cluster environment are not in packet; per-record input, label and attention hashes cannot be recomputed from original tensors. The receipt is internally consistent but not independently authenticated execution.

findings.text: The user-provided raw manifest has the exact requested SHA-256; all 150 listed entries match packaged file sizes and hashes. The CPU receipt and two prior reviews have valid canonical content seals. The exact requested CPU receipt hash is reproduced.

All 142 source snapshots in the primary runtime binding match the receipt and manifest, including untouched FastChat/train/train.py and the additive adapter, masking helper, training utility and CPU runner. This does not independently authenticate the live cluster source files.

The implementation checks unique IDs, full-record digest, role/ordinal and explicit boolean assistant annotations; uses exact native assistant ranges; removes labels only on false ranges and keeps true ranges; refuses truncated, mismatched or zero-target examples. Inclusion of terminators and prefix-space boundaries relies on the shared render/native_record_audit logic, not on an independently implemented tokenizer.

Adapter constructs output input_ids and attention_mask directly from native preprocessing, changes only labels, and does not perform a second causal shift. The CPU runner compares those arrays against native processing and rejects a zero effective post-position-0 target. Actual native tensors were not included for independent equality checking.

Adapter deep-copies input records and annotations; derives cache keys from full record, annotation, policy version and binding; returns copies to callers. CPU runner tests a reverse-ordered eager dataset against a forward lazy dataset, and the stub-backed tests verify cache isolation and reverse-order agreement.

The sealed CPU receipt advertises eager_lazy_shuffled_identity=true, but the supplied CPU runner actually uses DataLoader(shuffle=False) and a deterministic reversed eager dataset; no randomized DataLoader iteration or multi-seed permutation is implemented. The assertion should be relabeled and a true shuffle test added.

Both the adapter and its independent-expected computation rely on the same native_record_audit assistant boundaries; supporting fixed-answer tests cover only two simple assistant spans and do not cover the full independently specified terminator, adjacent-special-token, separator-space, repeated-text and first/last turn permutations. Independent fixtures must not obtain their expected boundaries from the code under test.

The primary binding includes 142 FastChat and adapter/runner source files, but imported helper modules (at minimum seek.schemas, seek.storage and seek.three_way.core) are omitted. Those appear in the receipt’s broader 95-entry source map, but source bytes for these helpers are not in this packet; the checked receipt binding does not directly cover them.

CPU runner checks batched per-row values, CPU device and int64 dtype for input_ids/labels, but does not explicitly assert attention_mask dtype or standalone padding invariants. require_integration_receipt rejects old receipt schemas but is not wired to an opt-in training-launch gate; these facts must not be read as training readiness.

The 1,858 record rows reconcile to 609,507 original supervised tokens, 434,727 retained tokens, 174,780 removed labels, 4,671 false and 9,675 true assistant turns; 929 two-record batches is arithmetically consistent. Every row retains positive post-first-token targets and has distinct record/cache IDs.

The inspected CPU validation code loads only tokenizer and dataset/collation dependencies, not model weights or an optimizer. The sealed receipt claims model_calls=0; independent review did not access cluster runtime, so actual cluster activity is not authenticated.

required_changes_for_full_cpu_acceptance.text: Produce a new immutable CPU receipt that distinguishes reversed eager/lazy agreement from a genuine randomized shuffled DataLoader check. Run seeded shuffled permutations and verify ID/content/cache-key/label identity across order and batching.

Add hand-authored, fixed expected-token/label fixtures covering first/last false and true turns, native terminators, adjacent special tokens, separator spaces, repeated text, empty/missing/bad annotations, and overlapping/unstable/truncated boundaries. The oracle must not call annotation_mask or reuse its boundary derivation.

Extend the pinned runtime-source binding and review snapshots to included helper dependencies (particularly seek.schemas, seek.storage and seek.three_way.core) used for hashing, receipts and validation. Rerun CPU validation under that complete pinned source contract.
Assert batched attention_mask dtype, shapes, padding and label-position alignment explicitly, including an expected post-shift synthetic target map without running a model.

outstanding_prerequisites_not_in_this_re: Independently replay the native 1,858-record tokenization if the tokenizer binaries/assets and complete corpus are made available; the present receipt is only a cluster claim plus internal consistency checks.
Connect and review the opt-in training-launch gate that requires this exact new adapter receipt and source binding; existing require_integration_receipt is not an installed launch gate.
Assemble and separately validate final C, LQ, LO corpora, including explicit attack-action target ordinals, loss:true targets and matched benign annotations.
Authenticate original annotation intent, clean-source provenance, split independence, checkpoint matching, and train resource feasibility in separate reviews.
